text.en: Pet owners celebrate groomers Ren, Dana, Josephine, and Angel for their warm demeanor and dedicated attention to pets with special needs. Clients frequently mention that front desk receptionist Carol is very welcoming and that groomers willingly accommodate senior dogs, cats, and difficult pets that other shops turn away.

title.en: Gentle handling for senior and nervous pets

text.en: Reviewers emphasize how calm and comfortable their animals remain during appointments, highlighting safe handling for dogs up to 17 years old with heart conditions. While one client reported an accidental minor nick during clipping, the vast majority note that fearful pets settle down and come home completely relaxed.

title.en: Skilled breed styling with isolated cut mishaps

text.en: Most clients praise tidy haircuts, stylish lion cuts on cats, and specialized scissor work on breeds like cocker spaniels and Maltese dogs. However, two negative reviews reported styling miscommunications, citing an unwanted close shave over the stomach and a painful clipper scratch that upset the owner.

q.en: Do they groom senior dogs with health conditions?

a.en: Yes, groomers like Ren regularly accommodate senior dogs, adjusting techniques to reduce stress for pets with heart conditions or arthritis.

q.en: Are cats accepted for lion cuts and baths?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviews praise the staff for handling cat grooming, including stress-free lion cuts and thorough deshedding washes.

q.en: How does the salon handle difficult or reactive dogs?

a.en: Groomers such as Jo and Angel are known for their patience with challenging dogs that other facilities have turned away.
